title: Safe Haven
tagline: A frontend interface that integrates a Safe plugin to manage permissioned addresses and call arbitrary data.
description: Safe haven builds upon the existing plugin ecosystem of Safes. By integrating the allowlist plugin into your Safe, the owner gains the capability to execute transactions to allowlisted accounts. The inspiration for this project was to design a frontend that seamlessly incorporates the allowlist plugin, facilitating arbitrary functions to be executed within the Safe's context.
how_its_made:
This project is a Next.js application that extensively incorporates wagmi React hooks. It leverages existing smart contracts to capitalize on the modularity of the Safe ecosystem.

Much of the project's initial complexity centered on integrating the Safe ecosystem tools. This involved navigating public repositories, reading documentation, and watching videos.
